Name: Jar Opener - Edible Artisan Goods
Author: genowhirl9999
Description:
This mod modifies Jelly, Pickles, Mayo and Honey so that they are edible and give reasonable amounts of health and energy when consumed.

If you have an item from a save without this mod it should still work you just need to pick up the item first. Similarly, if you have an item in your inventory from an unmodded save putting the item in a box and picking it back up should fix any issues.

In multiplayer there might be some minor issues with the energy/health values if only some players have the mod so it's recommended everyone downloads it.

This should be compatible with most mods as it only modifies the edibility of these specific items and nothing else. So it may cause issues if another mod is doing the same thing but from what I've found it's compatible with basic stuff like PPJA.

JA does seem to have some kind of shuffled ID bug that may cause issues though so be aware of that.

There is also a minor issue where jelly placed in a chest with the automate mod will show the wrong energy in the chest but will be fixed as soon as you pick it up. This is just a product of how the mod works so I'll have to look into accounting for that but it shouldn't have any impact on gameplay since you have to pick up food to eat it anyway.

Downloads.Description: Fixed an error that can happen with certain other mods installed. Fixed minor issue with generic pickles/jelly.
